units.source_text: “你不要这么煞有介事地问这个好不好！”

en.t: Please do not ask me that in such a solemn way.

units.source_text: “我没有煞有介事地问哪，您的意思是说我已经知道了？”

en.t: I am not asking solemnly. Do you mean that I already know?

units.source_text: “如果这么忠实于先生的夫人突然不在了，先生会变成什么样子？

en.t: If you, who are so devoted to Sensei, were suddenly gone, what would become of him?

units.source_text: 对社会的各个方面都觉得无趣的先生，倘若您突然不在之后会怎样呢？

en.t: Sensei finds nothing interesting in any part of society, so what would happen after you suddenly disappeared?

units.source_text: 我说的不是从先生的角度看，而是从您的角度看，先生是会幸福还是会不幸呢？”

en.t: I do not mean from Sensei's point of view, but from yours: would he be happy or unhappy?

units.source_text: “从我这方面看，我可以告诉你（也许先生不这样看），他若是离开我，只能变得不幸，或者会生活不下去的。

en.t: From my side, I can tell you, though Sensei may not see it that way, that if he left me he could only become unhappy, or perhaps be unable to go on living.

units.source_text: 我这样说，显得很自负，可是我相信，现在只有我能够使先生过得尽可能幸福。

en.t: It sounds very conceited for me to say this, but I believe that right now only I can make Sensei as happy as possible.

units.source_text: 我相信，没有人能够像我这样使他幸福，正因为如此，我才能这样平静。”

en.t: I believe no one can make him happy the way I can, and that is exactly why I can be so calm.

units.source_text: “我觉得夫人的这种信念，应该反映在先生心里呀。”

en.t: I think that conviction of yours ought to be reflected in Sensei's heart.
Do you mean to say that Sensei is tired of you?

units.source_text: “我并不认为他厌烦我，他没有厌烦我的理由。

en.t: I do not think he is tired of me. He has no reason to be tired of me.

units.source_text: 但是，他厌恶社会，近来又由厌恶社会发展到厌恶人，

en.t: But he hates society, and lately his hatred of society has grown into hatred of people.

units.source_text: 所以我作为人的一分子，怎么可能得到他的好感呢？”

en.t: So as one human being among others, how could I possibly win his affection?

units.source_text: 我终于理解了夫人所说的被厌烦的含意。

en.t: At last I understood what his wife meant by being tired of her.
